fields.label: Telephony Account

fields.description: The numbers patients dial to reach this product line. A call on a number listed nowhere is ignored. Leave empty for outbound only.

fields.description: Outgoing calls on this product line's leads are credited only to the lead's owner or an assignee. Anyone else's call is logged with no one credited, and they cannot click-to-call the lead. Incoming calls are not affected.
fields.label: Credit Outgoing Calls Only to the Lead's Owner or Assignees

fields.description: People with any of these roles are credited on every lead. Pick a role reps never hold, such as a Helpdesk role.
fields.label: Exempt Roles
